settings.name: Green Valley Homestay
settings.tagline: A quiet farm stay in the hills
settings.about: Four rooms on a working cardamom farm, twenty minutes above Munnar town. Home-cooked meals and a plantation walk every morning.
settings.directions: Munnar bus stand is 9 km — we can pick you up.

rooms.name: Garden Room
rooms.shortDescription: Opens onto the garden, with a sit-out for morning tea.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.shortDescription: Room for four, with a view over the plantation.
